title: Numeric field read through REDEFINES of invalid data
business_name: Invalid amount silently treated as zero
business_cause: Corrupted input amounts are processed as zero instead of following the same recovery rules as COBOL.
probable_cause: Faulty Java rejects invalid numeric data under REDEFINES.
technical_cause: Faulty Java rejects invalid numeric data under REDEFINES.
business_fix: Apply the same recovery rule the COBOL program uses for corrupted amounts: extract digits from invalid bytes instead of rejecting them.
fix_sentence: Use the low nibble of each byte as the digit value, as the GnuCOBOL reference does.
